name: Takatou Yukari
source:
Stepmother of Kakeru and Yui. She married into the Takatou family as the second wife when Kakeru and Yui were little.

She had no intention of acting like a stepmother, and from the very beginning did her best to become like a real mother to the children. She was none the wiser that the children could see right through her, and understood what she was doing.

She's a bit of an airhead. She has now remarried to a new husband, Fujio, and is enjoying her new life.

[Translated from the [url=https://t.vndb.org/cv/84/113184.jpg]game manual[/url]]
